Dear Madam Lilia:

Welcome to the Radiant Feldspar's restaurant. Today, a very special person wishes for us to express his most heartfelt blessings to you on his behalf:

"Lilia,
On this remarkable night, may you live a life that is full of endless love and affection. I love you, Lilia. My feelings for you will never change, even with the passing of time. I have prepared a surprise for you and I hope that you'll have fun tonight. :)
Mike"

On behalf of all the staff in our department, I offer our best wishes to you. Happy birthday! May you enjoy a magical night full of joy and merriment.

Radiant Feldspar Food & Beverage Department
